benefit.principle: Empirical benefit requires a separate passing policy-outcome gate.

freshness.principle: Current source and raw evidence hashes prevent inherited outcomes.

readiness.principle: Matched-key, fresh-reset, and provenance fixtures define collector readiness only.

retention.principle: Persist, reload, update, release, and duplicate rejection must pass.

validity.principle: All protocol fixtures and declared checks must pass before empirical rows are readable.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: A no-model measurement uses an empty model list.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Validity, readiness, benefit, retention, and freshness have separate results.
field_principles.duration_s: Current monotonic time is measured and never padded or inherited.
field_principles.field_principles: One-line reasons travel with each governed field.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Persist the terminal reader result; flagged evidence never opens readiness.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every block names check, upstream, path, field, operator, expected, and observed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use a complete_ terminal prefix; completion alone is not scientific benefit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The value describes this current no-LLM offline-arcade execution.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Planned and actual classes stay separate; blocked_no_run means no model work.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Current loads, forwards, generations, and tokens are counted separately.
field_principles.matched_protocol_path: The frozen roster, prefix cap, target key, and game unit define the protocol.
field_principles.matched_support_ready_score: One means matched-key, fresh-reset, and provenance fixtures conform only.
field_principles.random_seed: Every stochastic collector stage has an explicit seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The digest binds configuration, immutable raw evidence, and reduction.
field_principles.rows: Each independent game and arm keeps absolute operands, seed, direction, censoring, and provenance.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Repeated seeds and replays never multiply independent games or matched keys.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Runtime prefixes are live agent self-discovery; no new game solve is claimed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Producer artifacts, pre-gate records, and missing producers remain distinct.
field_principles.supervisor_scope: Only current fired and helped ledger counts support refinement.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Commands, exits, worktree, log hashes, and terminal readers bind validation.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use exactly positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Exact fixtures calibrate the protocol and cannot prove learned semantic correctness.

protocol_fixtures.methodology_note: Exact fixture outcomes calibrate the protocol and are not empirical benefit.
